title: Tuza's Conjecture
exact_target: Is the smallest number of edges meeting every triangle at most twice the largest number of edge-disjoint triangles?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1425 (GRAPH-038). CC BY 4.0.
